Careers
Careers links
St Joseph’s College is delighted to announce that we are nationally assessed as achieving the Quality in Careers Standard, fully meeting all the accreditation criteria incorporating the Gatsby Benchmarks. The Quality in Careers Standard is the national quality award for careers education, information, advice, and guidance (CEIAG) in secondary schools, colleges and work-based learning. The Standard is “strongly recommended” by and fully complies with the Department for Education’s statutory guidance.St Joseph’s College is committed to developing well informed aspirational students who have the skills and attributes to succeed in the twenty-first century workplace.We have well established partnerships to inspire and inform our students. The Peter Jones Academy offers students the chance to develop their business ideas into reality. The University of Sussex and Royal Holloway University have chosen us as one of their partner schools and students visit have had the chance to visit, taste University life and enjoy tasters in different subjects. The Brokerage, Urban Synergy, Amazing Apprenticeships and the Association for BAME Engineers all provide opportunities for our students to visit professional workplaces and we work with a network of local employers to provide assemblies and support employability skills. Year 11 have benefited from practice interviews with local employers to support with their transitions.Students can access independent careers advice through our onsite qualified Careers Adviser.We welcome parent’s support and feedback for our careers programme please use the form below if you have any comments. If could you offer your time for practice interviews, work experience or careers talk please use this form To ensure the effectiveness of our careers education, information, advice and guidance (CEIAG) programme we conduct a review every year. Our next review date is July 2023. Our evaluation activities include
